display_shell:
**Proposed anonymized lesson**
When [general situation], AskRigor should [correct behavior] because [reason].

**Submit this anonymized lesson to improve AskRigor?**
Reply: **Yes**, **Yes always in this chat**, or **No**.

incident_receipts.PARTIAL_TRANSCRIPT_PRESERVED: Only part of the lesson incident could be preserved exactly.
incident_receipts.LESSON_ONLY_NO_TRANSCRIPT: The generalized lesson is available, but the exact originating transcript is not.
incident_receipts.RAW_INCIDENT_NOT_PRESERVED: The exact lesson incident was not preserved.

generalized_receipts.submitted: Anonymized lesson submitted as candidate {candidate_id}. It requires review before changing AskRigor. Anonymous occurrence count: {occurrence_count}.
generalized_receipts.existing_candidate: Lesson already existed as {candidate_id}; anonymous occurrence count is now {occurrence_count}.
generalized_receipts.privacy_rejected: Lesson not submitted: privacy screening rejected the candidate.
generalized_receipts.rate_limited: Lesson not submitted: submission is rate limited. Try again after {retry_after_seconds} seconds.
generalized_receipts.anonymizer_unavailable: Lesson not submitted: privacy generalization is unavailable.
generalized_receipts.github_unavailable: Lesson not submitted: the private review queue is unavailable.
generalized_receipts.incident_unavailable: Anonymized lesson not submitted: the exact source incident could not be preserved.

cases.scenario: A criticism is rechecked and validated with no standing consent.
The user replies exactly Yes to one displayed validated lesson.
The user enables standing consent and a second lesson is independently validated later in the same chat.
The pending-candidate response is No, silence, ambiguous assent, or a changed subject.
The criticism remains unverified or is only a preference disagreement.
The user authorizes a validated lesson but private incident preservation fails.
receipts: The exact lesson incident was not preserved.
Anonymized lesson not submitted: the exact source incident could not be preserved.
